correctness.rationale: The absolutely convergent product has a zero precisely when a finite cyclotomic factor vanishes. Prime-power divisibility and nonnegative total weight p force exactly one p-gon of residues containing 0; the first nonzero p-adic layer is unique. Independent exact finite arithmetic checks agree. Finite-scale counting and a p^{-Ld} residual density bound rigorously give the infinite density.
